integrity: Explicit Hermitian form, Frobenius-frame proof, and executable GF(64) incidence check are provided. No independent validation or audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the generator complement of a smooth Hermitian surface over its natural finite field; orbit assertion is over the degree-three extension. Classical point counts and generator geometry are credited; possible earlier polar-geometry equivalent orbit classification remains a priority risk.
title: A single unitary orbit of degree-three points outside the generators of a Hermitian surface
